recyclingTarget.description: Recycling target expressed in decimal form

businessCountry.description: Business country of the submitting organisation

issuedAt.description: Time the PRN or PERN was issued, returned at UTC offset zero. For RREPW and epr-backend records this is also the authorisation time.

createdAt.description: Time the PRN record was created in the source store, returned at UTC offset zero. Source-store timestamps are not directly comparable across PRN pools.

updatedAt.description: Time the PRN record was last updated in the source store, returned at UTC offset zero. Source-store timestamps are not directly comparable across PRN pools.

acceptedAt.description: Time the PRN or PERN was accepted, returned at UTC offset zero. Null when no acceptance event exists or when the source cannot supply lifecycle-event timestamps.

rejectedAt.description: Time the PRN or PERN was rejected, returned at UTC offset zero. Null when no rejection event exists or when the source cannot supply lifecycle-event timestamps.

cancelledAt.description: Time the PRN or PERN was cancelled, returned at UTC offset zero. Null when no cancellation event exists or when the source cannot supply lifecycle-event timestamps.

name.description: Recipient legal name when supplied by a richer source. PRN common backend and legacy PRN records return null because they retain only a selected display name.

tradingName.description: Recipient trading name when supplied by a richer source. PRN common backend and legacy PRN records return null because they retain only a selected display name.

oneOf.description: Recipient registration type when supplied by epr-backend. PRN common backend and legacy PRN records return null because they do not retain this value.
